summary: Iteration 17 verification: 6 changes (TopBar, FabBar redesign, PWA dynamic manifest, admin map_enabled toggle, sms.ru callcheck registration, media queries) tested E2E. All 10 backend pytest cases green (manifest, public settings, admin settings save/read, PWA icon upload, callcheck disabled/existing/graceful/404/400, SMS regression). Frontend: customer & driver TopBars render (white bg, position:absolute, top:0), menu-btn/top-bar-name/top-bar-status all present, FabBar shows icon-above-label (flex-direction column), fab-modal open/close works, all 11 admin settings testids for map/PWA/call-verify cards found, save works, map_enabled=false replaces Yandex map with data-testid=map-disabled-bg. All mutated settings restored at end of tests (map_enabled=true, call_verify_enabled=false, test_mode=true).

issues: OneSignal 'Получайте уведомления' slide-down banner overlays TopBar in top-right area on mobile viewport (390x844) — visually covers a portion of the top-bar-status pill and stole the burger click during automated testing until dismissed. Not a regression from this iteration but worth checking z-index priority when burger button is intended to be reachable.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2480-2503 (manifest.json) — icons array can be empty if no icons uploaded; some browsers warn on empty icons. Consider embedding a fallback base64 or default asset when both pwa_icon_192_url and app_icon_url are empty. LOW.

server.py:942-951 (callcheck/status) — endpoint returns 404 when the record exists but device_id mismatches. Correct security posture but log line would help debugging: system_log 'callcheck/status: device_id mismatch'. LOW.

server.py:904-914 (callcheck/start) — when sms.ru upstream fails (network or non-OK) endpoint gracefully falls back to {method:'sms'} which is the documented behavior. Good. But note: the caller's device_id one-hour count (line 900) is checked BEFORE the sms.ru attempt; a failed upstream still consumes a rate-limit slot conceptually only via `callcheck_requests` insert on success — that insert is skipped on failure, so rate limit is actually NOT consumed on failure. Verify this matches product intent.

InstallPrompt.jsx L37-38 — returns null if !settings AND early-returns before adding beforeinstallprompt handler cleanup in ordering; useEffect cleanup is fine but the axios .then chain doesn't respect an unmount race (missing isMounted guard). LOW.

index.html L23 fetch('/api/settings/public') — the OneSignal init block uses window.fetch on hard-coded relative path which works via ingress, but for local previews without the /api ingress this can silently fail. Consider REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL substitution at build. LOW.
